title: Rosehill College at Te Ahurea 2026
excerpt: Rosehill College was proud to be involved in Te Whare Haka ō Pukeroihi – Te Ahurea 2026 at Alfriston College, celebrating Māori culture, performing arts and kotahitanga.
body:
Rosehill College was proud to be part of **Te Whare Haka ō Pukeroihi – Te Ahurea 2026**, hosted at Alfriston College.

The event provided an opportunity to celebrate Māori culture, identity and performing arts, while bringing rangatahi together through kapa haka, cultural expression and kotahitanga.

We acknowledge and celebrate the students and staff who represented Rosehill College and contributed to this special occasion. Their participation reflects the importance of cultural pride, connection and the sharing of traditions within our school community.

**Ka mau te wehi, Rosehill!**
